newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Arnotts is subject of poison biscuit scare.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Arnotts is subject of poison biscuit scare.

text.p: An extortionist has threatened to plant poisoned biscuits in supermarkets unless police undergo a lie detector test over an old murder case, Australian police said on Thursday.

Queensland police superintendent Ron Pickering told a news conference on Thursday night that an extortion letter and packages containing poisoned biscuits were received by a leading food company in the states of New South Wales and Queensland on February 3.
Local media said the biscuit products of Arnotts Ltd were the subject of the threat.
